Hi, I’m Tatianna!

I’m a community manager and content creator who’s passionate about storytelling and the power of words. With a background in marketing and international business, I love turning ideas into content people actually stop for.

I bring strategy, creativity and heart to every brand I work with, from food and fashion to health campaigns.

I’m on a mission to make marketing feel real, intentional and fun. Based in Tegucigalpa, Honduras, and always learning, I’m looking for projects where creativity and strategy go hand in hand. Let’s create something that actually connects!
